unsupportedReasons.no-transaction-data: has no resale transactions in the current dataset, so there is nothing to compare yet.
unsupportedReasons.thin-data: has too few resale transactions in the current dataset for a reliable comparison.
unsupportedReasons.new-launch: is a new launch. Comparisons that include a new launch are not available yet.
unsupportedReasons.no-report: No comparison has been generated for this pair yet.
unsupportedReasons.ambiguous: More than one development matches. Choose the one you mean.

enquiry.note: Messages never carry income, CPF, cash or debts. Report-level refs (for example JDT3-P1) and their P1 to P3 and S0 to S3 tags are unchanged and stay inside the reports.

analytics.note: Events are sent to GA4 and Meta only on a live host. Everywhere else they are captured in window.dataLayer and, with KPT_DEBUG, logged.

events.research_report_selected: A report opened from the library, a project page or the homepage (params: report, pair, source)
events.research_report_viewed: A report page opened (params: report, pair, build_id, status)
events.research_pair_checked: Two developments checked in the compare tool (params: project_a, project_b, supported, reason)
events.research_project_selected: A project chosen in the compare tool (existing event name reused; params: project_id, source)
events.research_whatsapp_clicked: WhatsApp enquiry opened from a Research page or inside a report (existing event name reused; params: context, ref)
events.project_profile_viewed: A project profile opened (params: project_id, content_level)
events.project_whatsapp_clicked: WhatsApp enquiry opened from a project profile (params: project_id, ref)
events.microsite_clicked: Outbound click to a project microsite (params: project_id, destination_host, placement)
events.tiktok_click: TikTok link opened (existing event name reused)
events.nav_click: Header navigation used (existing event name reused)

levels.BASIC: Verified basic information and any available transaction analysis. No microsite or floor plans required.
levels.FEATURED: More detailed curated information and related comparisons. A content-depth label, not a ranking or an endorsement.
levels.MICROSITE: A dedicated, independently maintained project website. KPT links to it and never copies it.
